intro: Lesson 17: Life in Roman Britain: Londinium and Hadrian's Wall. To understand what daily life was like in Roman Britain, in a town and on the frontier

questions.model: Londinium was by the Thames. It kept growing after the Romans. Today it is London.

questions.q: About when did Roman rule in Britain end?
In the portal response box, answer the big question: 'I would rather... because...' Give two facts about each place in your answer.
questions.a: A choice using facts, e.g. Londinium: baths, trade; the Wall: cold, guarding
questions.model: Teacher models: 'I would rather live in Londinium because there were baths and markets. On the Wall it was cold...'

questions.q: Add your Roman timeline: invasion, Londinium, Hadrian's Wall, Romans leave.
questions.a: AD 43, about AD 50, AD 122, AD 410 in order

questions.q: Name two Roman things we still use or can see today.
questions.a: Roads, the site of London, Hadrian's Wall, baths in Bath

questions.q: Big question: Londinium or the Wall?
questions.a: A choice with reasons using facts about both places
